Title: Edit and delete an Analytics report
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.2/data-domains/analytics-reports/edit-and-delete-an-analytics-report
Content: You can delete an Analytics Reports from the expanded tile on the Data Domain homepage.

Note that only Owners of a Data Domain can delete Analytics Reports; Members of a domain will not see the three-dots menu on the right-hand side of the row of a report.

Content: To rename an Analytics report, use the three dots menu in the list of analytic reports.

Optionally, go to the Settings page (Don’t forget to click SAVE after you’ve edited a name or description).
